ev.q: annual TB incidences of 20.5--27.6 cases per 100,000 population
Among the 67 persons with LTBI diagnosed, treatment was initiated in 57 (85%)
annual TB incidences of 20.5--27.6 cases per 100,000 population
annual TB incidences for Mississippi during the same period decreased from 7.8 to 5.4 cases per 100,000 population
higher than those found in five other TB programs in a recent study of contact investigations
This report summarizes the results of an investigation of the patients and their contacts

methods_quotes.q: For contacts, LTBI was defined as infection in a patient with a tuberculin skin test (TST) > 5 mm induration
RFLP analysis using IS 6110 was performed on all culture isolates.
Treatment for LTBI was defined as complete if the patient had retrieved > 6 months of isoniazid
Contact investigation logs were reviewed and health department records used to establish outcomes of treatment for LTBI.
